Herramienta de diagnóstico de red para g:
A network diagnostics tool for gaming. It measures latency and packet loss to your router and Internet destinations, displays changes in real time, and provides statistics and a diagnosis to help identify connection issues.

You can pause sessions, generate reports, and export text or CSV files.
